g0Diagnosis: Canonical Qualified reproduction #157 on macOS 15.7.7 Apple Silicon proved the packaged backend and SQLite healthy, then reproduced the real JXA/Cocoa/WKWebView native-window failure as protocol does not exist (-2700). The only explicit protocol-name lookup was the unnecessary formal NSApplicationDelegate declaration in the existing JXA registered subclass. The corrective removes only that formal declaration while preserving NSObject delegate selectors, app.delegate assignment, backend serving, WKWebView content, SQLite persistence and user state.

Full Qualified must include backend full/race/randomized, renderer, Chrome and WebKit; the WebKit/macOS lane must execute the actual packaged fresh native startup, startup dwell, warm relaunch on the same profile, SQLite profile reuse, protocol-resolution regression and deterministic cleanup before merge.
releaseRule: One v18.9.1-development branch, one PR #69, fresh exact-head Fast + Qualified after Stable identity preparation, exact-head merge, then the single canonical G11-G16 release workflow. No retry/certification/promotion branch, no duplicate release workflow and no #70 executable work inside this corrective release.
